lesson.summary: Access/provenance caveats in research docs need a re-check trigger, not just a warning
lesson.synthesized_rule: A research doc that records an ACCESS limitation (blocked domain, rate limit, unavailable tool) must pair it with a re-check trigger, because the limitation is usually temporary while the degraded claims it produced are permanent. A stale access caveat silently keeps every claim that routed around it unverified, and makes the cheap fix look expensive. On reading such a caveat, re-test the access before trusting the workaround.
